cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
cues.zh: 你好，歡迎回來。

cues.en: Let's have a quick look at multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 快速看看多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: So, here's the equation for multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 這是方程式。

cues.en: As you can see, it's quite similar to the simple linear regression equation.
cues.zh: 可以看到與簡單線性迴歸相當類似。

cues.en: Here we've got the dependent variable, then we've got the Y intercept of the constant.
cues.zh: 有依變數，再是 Y 軸截距，也就是常數。

cues.en: Then we've got a slope coefficient and independent variable, and then we've got more pairs of those.
cues.zh: 接著一個斜率係數乘自變數，再加更多組這種項。

cues.en: Then we've got another slope coefficient and independent variable and so on, and another slope coefficient and independent variable.
cues.zh: 再一個斜率係數與自變數，繼續下去。

cues.en: So, basically we have as many slope coefficients as we have independent variables.
cues.zh: 基本上，有幾個自變數，就有幾個斜率係數。

cues.en: Now, going back to our example of producing potatoes on a farm, we might want to predict how many potatoes we are yielding depending
cues.zh: 回到農場馬鈴薯例子，可能希望根據

cues.en: on how many kilograms of nitrogen fertilizer we're using, what the average temperature in the season is, and what the millimeters, how many millimeters
cues.zh: 使用多少公斤氮肥、生長季平均溫度，

cues.en: of rainfall we've seen in the season.
cues.zh: 以及該季降雨毫米數，來預測產量。

cues.en: So, the potatoes in this case, the equation for potatoes would be, for example, eight tons would be a Y intercept.
cues.zh: 這個例子的方程式，Y 軸截距可能是 8 噸。

cues.en: Then three tons per kilogram would be the amount of fertilizer, the coefficient for fertilizer used.
cues.zh: 肥料係數可能每公斤 3 噸。

cues.en: Then for average temperature in degrees Celsius, we might have a negative 0.54 tons per degrees Celsius.
cues.zh: 以攝氏度衡量的平均溫度，係數可能每度 -0.54 噸。

cues.en: And what that means is that the higher the temperature, the less potatoes will be yielded.
cues.zh: 代表溫度越高，收成越少。

cues.en: And then for the rainfall might be 0.04 tons per millimeter.
cues.zh: 降雨則可能每毫米 0.04 噸。

cues.en: Now to finish up, what I wanted to say is that this, we won't be using this example in our practical tutorials.
cues.zh: 最後補充，實作不會使用這個案例。

cues.en: It'll be a different example.
cues.zh: 會用另一個例子。

cues.en: It'll be fun and interesting example as well.
cues.zh: 也會很有趣。

cues.en: But if you wanted to learn more about potatoes and specifically the applications of multiple linear regression, here's a research paper that you might be interested in.
cues.zh: 如果想了解馬鈴薯，尤其是多元線性迴歸的應用，有篇研究可能感興趣。

cues.en: It's called "The Application of Multiple Linear Regression and Artificial Neural Network Models for Yield Prediction of Very Early Potato Cultivators Before Harvest".
cues.zh: 叫做〈The Application of Multiple Linear Regression and Artificial Neural Network Models for Yield Prediction of Very Early Potato Cultivators Before Harvest〉。

cues.en: So, this paper combines multiple linear regression and neural networks.
cues.zh: 這篇結合多元線性迴歸與神經網路。

cues.en: It looks at two different ways of modeling them.
cues.zh: 觀察兩種建模方式。

cues.en: Of course, you can just focus on the multiple linear regression if you like.
cues.zh: 當然，也可以只關注多元線性迴歸。

cues.en: It's quite an interesting read, and it can give you some additional deeper knowledge into the world of harvesting potatoes and multiple linear regression there.
cues.zh: 很值得閱讀，能更深入了解馬鈴薯收成，以及多元線性迴歸的應用。

cues.en: Other than that, enjoy the practical tutorials of Adlan and I'll see you back here next time.
cues.zh: 除此之外，享受 Hadelin 的實作教學，我們下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受機器學習的樂趣吧。
